plain: To follow a rule, standard, or custom

webster.text: Made to resemble; assuming the same form; like; resembling.

more.text: To make agreeable to; to square with a rule or directory.
To comply with or yield to; to live or act according to; as, to conform to the fashion or to custom.
To comply with; to obey; as, to conform to the laws of the state.

example.quote: Because the passions of men will not conform to the dictates of reason and justice, without constraint.
